articles.title: Watching Your Brain on Beauty
articles.summary: What happens inside your head when you see something really beautiful? Scientists in Italy hooked up a reporter to brain sensors and showed her a 400-year-old brass instrument used by Galileo. They’re trying to find the “beauty spot” in the brain.

articles.title: Tiny Thermometers Inside Cells Could Spot Cancer
articles.summary: Scientists in Japan built a super-small thermometer that works inside living cells. It’s made from special crystals and can measure temperature more precisely than ever before. One day, it might help doctors find diseases like cancer.

articles.title: A Greener Way to Get Lithium — From a Shower Remodel?
articles.summary: Lithium powers your phone and electric cars, but mining it is messy and expensive. Now, scientists found a cleaner, cheaper way to pull lithium from rocks — and the idea came from a home improvement store!
